owners.label: Voyager's Blaze
owners.description: Healing provided by Waves of Acclaims is increased by 20%.

owners.label: Trial by Fire and Tide
owners.description: Brant's resistance to interruption is increased during Mid-air Attacks and gains 15% Fusion DMG Bonus.

owners.label: The Course is Set!
owners.description: Amplify the incoming Resonator's Fusion DMG by 20% and Resonance Skill DMG by 25% for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.

owners.label: By Currents and Winds
owners.description:
Returned from Ashes temporarily causes nearby targets to stagnate while casting. The stagnation effect is removed when Brant is switched off the field.
After casting Intro Skill Applaud for Me! or each flip following Mid-air Attack, Brant's DMG dealt is increased by 20% for 5s, stacking up to 3 times.

owners.label: For Smiles and Cheers
owners.description:
Casting Mid-air Attack and Returned from Ashes increases Brant's Crit. Rate by 30%.
Brant's Outro Skill The Course is Set! gains a new enhancement:
When Resonance Skill cast by the incoming Resonator (or nearby Resonators who activate Brant's Outro Skill) hits a target within 20s after Brant's Outro Skill, Brant blasts the hit target, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 440% of Brant's ATK (considered Basic Attack DMG). This explosion can be triggered 1 time per second, up to 2 explosions in total.
- This effect remains active when Brant is switched off the field.

owners.label: Through Storms I Sail
owners.description: The DMG Multiplier of Returned from Ashes is increased by 42%.

owners.label: To Freedom I Sing
owners.description: The Shield obtained from Returned from Ashes is increased by 20%. Casting Returned from Ashes restores HP for all nearby Resonators in the team (6.60 HP for every 1% Energy Regen).

owners.label: All the World's an Actor's Stage
owners.description: Dealing Basic Attack DMG gives Brant 15% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 10s.

owners.label: All the World's a Captain's Carnevale
owners.description: Mid-air Attack's DMG Multiplier is increased by 30%. Casting Returned from Ashes causes a secondary blast, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 30% of the DMG dealt by Returned from Ashes, considered Basic Attack DMG.

owners.label: "My" Moment
owners.description: Brant upgrades Theatrical Moment into "My" Moment.

owners.label: The Course is Set!
owners.description: Brant grants Fusion Amplify and Resonance Skill Amplify to the incoming Resonator.
